Chapter 7006: Fortress Race

Chapter 7006: Fortress Race

Till Ancestor frowned upon hearing this. Alas, it was indeed the truth, and he didn’t mind it at all. After all, mortal beings could die for countless reasons, if not his tribulation.

Life and death were a normal cycle for mortals. Given their age, they have seen countless ones.

“Either way, this place is not suitable for an ocean. Please find another place.” Till Ancestor uttered coldly.

“Looks like you wish to antagonize me.” River God said.

“Fellow Daoist, there’s nothing I can do if you believe so.” Till Ancestor said.

“Fine, then a fight it is. I would like to see your seed dao then.” River God said.

“I will comply with your request.” Till Ancestor soared into the air, accepting the challenge.

The fight attracted the attention of overlords and immortals nearby, becoming confused at the feud.

“Excuse me, Fellow Daoist.” Till Ancestor swung his hoe. Its name was Ages, capable of flattening the ages.

Dusk shook violently as if the ground was being uplifted by each strike. Many became unstable as if lost in space.

“Bring it.” River God summoned a water dragon. As he poured his dao into it, it became resplendent.

It blocked the hoe to start the fight. Shockwaves emanated and obliterated everything in space.

“Are they serious?” An immortal commented.

“Over such a tiny place?” Someone else said.

“You must defeat him!” Mo Xiangsheng clenched his fists and cheered.

Ye Fantian sighed at the situation. Even if Till Ancestor were to win, this would only grant a fleeting reprieve. After all, the matter of the celestial source couldn’t be hidden forever. Once known, immortals from everywhere would fight to the death here.

“Boom!” Suddenly, a massive fortress appeared above her.

“Fortress race.” Spectators became startled.

It sent down thick stone pillars, drilling into the dynasty’s ancestral ground.

“Stop it!” Mo Xiangsheng and Ye Fantian took action, wanting to destroy them.

“Boom!” Once they got close, the pillars blasted them with golden light. This was the power of an exceptional immortal, sending them flying while vomiting blood.
